feedback: I want to retain the same visual fidelity, but I want you to change the game visuals as drastically as possible in the context of being in lava, and having an animated avatar, with more detail being added to the enemies and background, and nice subtle animations, can you do that for me

selection.reason: Changing visuals to a lava theme and adding animations can be accomplished by updating color constants in the prelude and completely overhauling the drawing logic in renderGame. Subtle animations can be driven by the p5.js frameCount.
